outcome: admission to the intensive care unit
cohort: 175 pregnant women with heart disease who gave birth
finding: Deviations from the European Society of Cardiology guidelines for mode of delivery in pregnant women with heart disease did not improve maternal outcomes and were associated with worse perinatal outcomes, primarily due to lower gestational age at birth.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery scheduled in disagreement with ESC guidelines was associated with a higher frequency of composite adverse neonatal outcomes.
